scripts.speaker: Rodel the Guard
scripts.text:
Traveling at such confusing times?
Villagers have been feeling more threatened by evil spirits recently.
Villagers are scared and trembling with fear.

scripts.speaker: Rodel the Guard
scripts.text:
So... the citizens of Port Malaya will feel uncomfortable around you even though there are no hard feelings toward you.
Inns and stops may be closed to outsiders.

scripts.speaker: Rodel the Guard
scripts.text:
There is no definite solution to this, but you might want to meet Phong in Mumbaki first.
If the village leader gives his confirmation, other people might be less worried.

scripts.speaker: Rodel the Guard
scripts.text:
I will mark on the map the location of Phong in Mumbaki.
I welcome your visit though the times are harsh.

scripts.speaker: Rodel the Guard
scripts.text:
Meet with Phong in Mumbaki first.
If you are proven to have a pure soul, other villagers will not avoid you.
If you are not sure of the location, I will mark it on your map.

scripts.speaker: Rodel the Guard
scripts.text:
How is the life here?
People aren't so bad are they?
If you were a little more skillful, there might be a job for you. Right now, you are little bit below the standard.

scripts.speaker: Rodel the Guard
scripts.text:
If you become stronger,
I was thinking of giving you the extermination mission that's being carried out in the city. What a shame.

scripts.speaker: Rodel the Guard
scripts.text:
Whew, thanks to you, I have one less thing to worry about.
I will lose less of my things.
Job well done.

scripts.speaker: Rodel the Guard
scripts.text:
You can come back if you want.
You understand what I mean right?

scripts.speaker: Rodel the Guard
scripts.text:
Oh, about Jejeling that you hunted down before.
People traveling in and out of Baryo are happy about it.
If it's not much too much trouble, I'd like to ask for your help one more time.

scripts.speaker: Rodel the Guard
scripts.text:
You don't have to do it now, just whenever you are comfortable.
Come and find me when you decide.

scripts.speaker: Rodel the Guard
scripts.text: Oh yes, there is a job for you if you are not too busy. Are you interested?

scripts.speaker: Rodel the Guard
scripts.text:
Recently, there have been a few that gained recognition for their bravery among the villagers.{0}, {1}, {2}... Isn't that amazing?
Oh yes, there is a job for you if you are not too busy. Are you interested?

scripts.speaker: Rodel the Guard
scripts.text:
Yesterday, I saw someone who was carried off to the hospital after rolling down the stairs at the park. That person went by the name of {0}. I wonder if that person is alright.
Oh yes, there is a job for you if you are not too busy. Are you interested?

scripts.speaker: Rodel the Guard
scripts.text:
The one who contributed the most in the Jejeling hunt was {0}.
Oh yes, there is a job for you if you are not too busy. Are you interested?

scripts.speaker: Rodel the Guard
scripts.text:
If you are bored, how about you stand guard for me? This is a heck of a job. You have to keep standing like a statue even till the sun rises up above your head.
Oh yes, there is a job for you if you are not too busy. Are you interested?

scripts.speaker: Rodel the Guard
scripts.text:
Have you been alone with a woman inside a Jeepney? Wow that was awkward...  I'm never going to get married at this rate...
Oh yes, there is a job for you if you are not too busy. Are you interested?

scripts.speaker: Rodel the Guard
scripts.text:
Recently among visitors, one became a close friend to me. Do you know {0}? Oh, of course you are a good friend as well.
Oh yes, there is a job for you if you are not too busy. Are you interested?

scripts.speaker: Rodel the Guard
scripts.text:
We are going to organize an extensive Jejeling hunt this time.
Peddlers going in and out of Baryo are always complaining about Jejelings.
Join the Jejeling hunt.
Refuse.

scripts.speaker: Rodel the Guard
scripts.text:
Is that so? I'm sorry to hear that.
Things would be so much simpler if we had a person like you around.

scripts.speaker: Rodel the Guard
scripts.text:
You just have to hunt 20 jejelings each.
It would be a simple task for you.

scripts.speaker: Rodel the Guard
scripts.text:
You have to get rid of 20 Jejelings.
20 should be enough to give those Jejelings a good scare.

scripts.speaker: Rodel the Guard
scripts.text:
Oh, the hunt is over, but you haven't killed all the Jejelings.
Come again if you want another try.

scripts.speaker: Rodel the Guard
scripts.text:
Oh, I have confirmed you got rid of 20 Jejelings.
Here, this is a reward for people who participated in the Jejeling hunt.

scripts.speaker: Rodel the Guard
scripts.text: I think there will be more Jejeling hunts in the future. Please join us again next time.

scripts.speaker: Rodel the Guard
scripts.text:
Please understand even if people look at you warily.
The ghost have been haunting the people around here.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Looks like this soul came across a big body of water.
Young friend.
The reason you found me... yes... I see.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
You don't have to say it in words.
The people are overly cautious of you.
Rodel was probably concerned about it, so he sent you here.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
No?
Well then maybe there was some kind of a Spiritual bond between us.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Nonetheless, good to meet you, young friend.
Don't blame the villagers too much for their attitudes toward you.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
We are always surrounded by spirits.
We live with them, praying for peace.
But recently, there has been a problem.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
For some unknown reason,
Spirits have been running amok, and evil sprits have been haunting the villagers.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
This is the shadow that is cast on this beautiful town.
They are cautious because they don't know when the dark shadow will fall on them.
They visit without warning.

^4d4dffPhong in Mumbaki turns his head and dark shadows appear.
People are in panic, everyone trembling with fear.^000000
Step toward the shadow.
Draw weapon.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
They have followed the trace of the outsider. 
Don't get to close too them.
Your soul can get absorbed.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Hmm? They are responding.
I don't understand? They look scared as if facing a powerful soul.
This feeling... it can't be...

^4d4dffLike words of Phong in Mumbaki, spirits are responding to something, hesitating.
Observing their reaction, you get closer. The spirits are flustered.^000000

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Amazing. Holder of a soul so strong and pure...!
The dark spirits have disappeared because of your presence.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
I think other villagers would treat you differently now...
Haven't we all witnessed this miracle?

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Young friend. Your presence is welcomed anywhere.
The light from your pure soul will protect you from the darkness.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Everyone in the village witnessed how strong and pure your soul is.
Do not be afraid of the dark.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Is there something wrong?
You look disturbed.
Your clothes also look messed up. Was there some kind of trouble?
Explain what happened.
There is nothing to talk about.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Is that so?
Ha ha... that is a big problem. 
You must've been concerned.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
You know, we were preparing a spiritual protection for 
villagers who are afraid of evil spirits...
but preparation is not going well.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
As a temporary solution, how about giving them what they want?
Just pick among the items you have that are unimportant and give them to them.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
All they want is inner peace anyways.
They give meaning to little things and find peace within that behavior.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
What is really important is the belief that you will be safe as long as you carry that item.
If people can stop being afraid by holding on to your old shirt button, then that button is a Spiritual Protection.

^4d4dffAs Mumbaki said, giving out some items to serve as a Spiritual Protection would be a good idea.
What would be adequate as a Spiritual Protection..^000000
Holy Water!
Holy magical item Blue Gemstone?!
Writing utensils or school supplies

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
The name itself suggests holiness.
It was blessed by the Holy Water, yes?
Not bad.
Is there another? Something more persuading would be nice.
Talk about Blue Gemstone.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Aha... a stone that disappears after absorbing the curse or magical affect instead of the holder.
Used in holy magic?
Sounds good.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Aha... a stone that disappears after absorbing the curse or magical affect instead of the holder.
Used in holy magic?
But it does not sound so holy though.
Talk about the Holy Water.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
The name itself suggests holiness.
It was blessed by the Holy Water, yes?
Sounds good.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Hmm? It isn't too bad if you are always going to carry it around.
But I think something that looks more persuading would be better.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
It would be better is there is a holy feel to it...
Do you have something that was blessed by your god?
Holy Water or Blue Gemstone?

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
The name itself suggests holiness.
It was blessed by the Holy Water, yes?
Stone that protects the bearer...
Sounds perfect.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Can you find Holy Water and Blue Gemstone that you spoke of?
While I'm working on the Spiritual Protection, you can give out the Holy Artifacts.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
People's trust toward you will grow stronger if you do that.
They will trust and listen to you.
Yes, because you will become their heart's savior.
^4d4dffListening to Phong in Mumbaki, you decided to give out Holy Water and Blue Gemstone to the villagers.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Is that so?
Tell me if anything happens.
For you, it'll be my pleasure to lend you a hand

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Holy Water and Blue Gemstone you spoke of will function well. 
I hope they can set aside their fear and worries this way...

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Did you give out your present to everyone?
By doing this, you made friends with everyone in the town.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
I found ways to build Spiritual Protection.
My grandchild Imelda will create it.
So don't worry. You don't have to give out any more of your things.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text: There was a traveler who is as brave as you. The traveler went by the name of {0}. Do you know that person?

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text: There is a traveler recently that has been gaining popularity in the village. The traveler's name was {0}. Outsiders seem to be very vigorous.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text: I have never in my life living as a Mumbaki seen a soul as pure and as strong as that of {0}'s. Yes, even stronger and purer than yours.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text: I witnessed a traveler who flipped backward after stepping on a fruit peel. {0}. He cried out 'Ouch! Somebody please help~'. We all had a good laugh.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text: Welcome! Welcome! You are always welcome around here.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text: I don't know if you are aware of this, but {0} even aided Baryo. I feel good to know that there is a one more good soul around.
Ask for advice.
Bless flowers...

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Ferry at the Port?
So that has happened...
Important thing is to first find out why that child is so upset.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
In this case, a bribe would work perfectly.
Flowers are always the best choice for seducing woman, right?
This is not a love consulting.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
I'm just saying.
Dead or alive, that poor soul is just a little girl.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Girls that age will smile even at the falling leaves.
Open her heart with an armful of flowers.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Let's see...
^4d4dff3 Mystic Flowers, 3 Elegant Flowers, 3 Pretty Flowers^000000 would be enough to make a Bouquet.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Gather these flowers, and I'll make a Bouquet out of it and bless it.
Flowers can be found out side the village.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
There are ^4d4dff3 Mystic Flowers, 3 Elegant Flowers, 3 Pretty Flowers^000000.
Do you understand?

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Oh... I can smell the scent of flowers from here.
I'll gather these and bless them.

-Phong in Mumbaki carries out a blessing ceremony after carefully tying flowers into a Bouquet.-
-Just by watching it, holiness overwhelms you.-

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Isn't it a beauty?
Not bad for a old man huh?
I made so many Offering Bouquets in the past that I can make one with my eyes closed now.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Now, deliver this to that child.
I hope she opens her heart with this and becomes willing to talk to you.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text: Take this Bouquet and talk to the spirit that has nested in the boat.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
It is a pity to see a misfortunate spirit... just as with that Ferry incident.
If you are going to offer a Bouquet for a spirit, I'm always willing to help.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
There is nothing this old man can tell you.
Nothing can beat staying healthy, right?

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Who is the floral tribute for?
Don't tell me you're making one in advance cause you're lazy?
A tribute must be sincere. Don't forget that.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Isn't it already made?
What is that in your hand?
Why are you standing around here? Go and give out those flowers.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Going to Diwata?
You need Mysterious Flowers, Elegant Flowers and Beautiful Flowers, 3 of each, okay?
I'll make it when the flowers are ready.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Diwata is some woman.
And you going to her every day is something too.

scripts.speaker: Phong in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Hey, here's the Bouquet.
Make offerings with your soul and wish for a fruitful day.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
..........
Not bad.
I have my eyes on you. Let's see how you do in this town.. *chuckle*
- She is a rather annoying little girl. -

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
Aren't you the hero who recently got on the villagers good side with the cheap foreign Holy Artifact?
What's up?
You want to make a traditional Spiritual Protection?

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
Yes. My grandfather found a way.
I'm going to make it.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
This is my job and nobody else's.
Protecting traditions is my job.
Is that so?
Good luck on your own!

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
Of course.
And to get help from someone as... weak as you is not such a good idea.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
Getting the materials is not as easy as it sounds.
Maybe when you become stronger, yes, but not now. Never.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
What then?
You're going to get the materials?
Fine I'll accept your proposal.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
If you wanted to help me out so much, why didn't you say so from the beginning?
Or ask my grandfather?

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
If you are so enthusiastic about making a Spiritual Protection.
I'd have to give up, won't I?

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text: Now, the needed materials are ^4d4dff6 Sharpened Bamboos, 6 Salt bags and 6 Silver Crosses^000000.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
You'll have to manufacture the salt yourself at the north western beach.
You'll find the pits I've made there.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
Go to Pandoi at the weapon shop for the Silver Crosses.
He promised to make me some.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
Sharpened Bamboos you can get at Baryo or from a nearby forest.
You got all that?

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text: Now's the time to prove your prowess!

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
Indeed.
I will protect the village!

Now I haven't seen any Spiritual Protections made with those!
Interesting~
I'm sure you'll do just fine~
Ha ha ha ha~

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text: Stop annoying me and go away!

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text: I'll approve you as worthy if you bring all the materials for the Spiritual Protection!

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
Manufacture the salt at the north western beach and bamboos grow in Baryo Mahiwaga.
Ask Pandoi to make the Silver Crosses.
Don't forget to get 6 of each.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
... Oh... My, you really did get them?
You're better than I thought.
That was not a compliment at all!

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
Now I'm going through the holy ritual to make a traditional Spiritual Protection.
Give them to me! And don't bother me during the process!

Imelda is in ritual with a devout aura, compared to when she streamed invectives.
Better not disturb her.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
Still here?
Of course, you want to see how much better my Spiritual Protection is compared to that cheap Holy Artifact.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
Fine.
Now go and give these Spiritual Protections to the people!
You have all the rights to do so!
*Giggles*

Took the Spiritual Protection, despite her ridiculous logic and vigor.
Let's give them to the villagers.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
Don't disturb the ritual and go away.
Please wait while I make the Spiritual Protection.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
The ones who gets the Spiritual Protections are on the list.
Go and give them the new Spiritual Protections

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
Such a kind person like yourself  will surely do it, won't you? 
*Smirk*

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
... You really did what I asked you?
You know what? I give up.
I thought you'd leave after getting something from this town with sweet talk...

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
I apologize for my rude behavior.
....This is something to go with the apology.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text: I'd be happy if you could help me, because the Spiritual Protections needs to be made every day.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
Hello there.
Did you enjoy the scenery of Malaya?
It's nice to have a chat with friends on a Jeepney.
I'll help you making Spiritual Protections.
Love and Spiritual Protection for all.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
Materials for making a Spiritual Protection are
Salt Bags, Silver Crosses and Sharpened Bamboos, 6 of each.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text: Salt form the north western beach, Silver Crosses from Pandoi, and Sharpened Bamboos from near Baryo.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
Yes, you got everything precisely.
Thanks for the help.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
It'll be nice if you could help again tomorrow.
Here's something for your trouble.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
I appreciate your kindness, but we have enough for today.
I'll ask for you when I need more materials.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
Very good timing.
I ran out of materials for today's Spiritual Protections.
Could you go for them now?
Sure.
I need some preparations.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
As usual then.
6 Salt Bags. Silver Crosses and Sharpened Bamboos, please.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
.......I see.
I'll be waiting then.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
That is great news indeed.
You know what you need for making Spiritual Protections?
Of course, it's not your first time...

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
I'll leave you to it then.
6 Salt Bags. Silver Crosses and Sharpened Bamboos, please.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
Please deliver these new Spiritual Protections to the villagers.
You know them, right?

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
They cannot rely on these Spiritual Protections forever...
It would be much better to have a strong mind such as yours.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
Strong spirits are full of light.
Those of the dark cannot approach due the blinding light

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
I guess that's it for today.
Thank you very much.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
The Spiritual Protections given before will still be in effect
It's okay for now.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
I was wondering when you would drop by.
Could you deliver Spiritual Protections to the folks today?
Of course.
Not today.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
Yes.
Why not take a stroll in Malaya today?
Of course, you'll still encounter ghosts here and there.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
Thank you very much.
Come back when you've given them all out.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
Thanks for your concern, but I couldn't make any because I ran out of materials.
Shame, is it not?
I do hope there's somebody willing to get them for me.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
Are you at peace? I could feel your serenity all the way from here.
You want to spend that extra time for me?

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text: Could you give out these Spiritual Protections to the villagers for me?
Yes.
Not today.

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
Yes.
Why not take a stroll in Malaya today?

scripts.speaker: Imelda
scripts.text:
Thank you very much.
Come back when you've given them all out.

scripts.text:

Shame, is it not?
I do hope there's somebody willing to get them for me.

scripts.speaker: Old Man Nardo
scripts.text:
.......
Not from around here, I see. I have nothing to say.

scripts.speaker: Old Man Nardo
scripts.text:
How about lending a hand for a poor old man?
I don't care if it's just a sleeve of your shirt, just give me something with your vigor.

scripts.speaker: Old Man Nardo
scripts.text:
You know, I've not long to go now...
Help me be at peace along the way.

scripts.speaker: Old Man Nardo
scripts.text:
Y... You!!
You're the young one with such strong spirit to fend off ghosts of darkness?!
Would it be... Possible to share some of your spirit with me?

scripts.speaker: Old Man Nardo
scripts.text: I have trouble sleeping because of the mischievous ghosts around town, and my back hurts when it rains.

scripts.speaker: Old Man Nardo
scripts.text:
Please share that miraculous spirit of yours with me.
How about just a button of yours?
-The troubled villagers desire your belongings because you fend off the ghosts. -
-So many have already asked you for this. Perhaps it will be better to speak with Phong in Mumbaki.-

He'll rake off all my buttons if I talk to him now.
Must counsel with Mumbaki first!

scripts.speaker: Old Man Nardo
scripts.text:
To be honest, I do not believe that this Holy Artifact has any abilities.
It's just for the peace of mind.

scripts.speaker: Old Man Nardo
scripts.text:
Nevertheless, I see you differently now
To exclude just because someone's an outsider doesn't seem like a good idea anymore.
I'm sorry I ignored you.
^4d4dffPrepare and give Blue Gemstone and Holy Water. ^000000

scripts.speaker: Old Man Nardo
scripts.text: So, changed your mind about sharing your spirit?
Hand over the prepared items.

scripts.speaker: Old Man Nardo
scripts.text:
Ahh... Thank you.
Now I can be at peace for some time...
...Peace is always good. Yes.

scripts.text:

It's just for the peace of mind.

scripts.speaker: Old Man Nardo
scripts.text:
When you have the time, could you help me out with something?
I'm fine now... I mean later.

scripts.speaker: Old Man Nardo
scripts.text: What is it?

scripts.speaker: Old Man Nardo
scripts.text:
Do you know Capre? I hear {0} travelers are helping out Capre... Anyhow...
What is it?

scripts.speaker: Old Man Nardo
scripts.text:
There are plenty of Spiritual Protection these days. {0} was keen at giving out Spiritual Protections. Is it a tradition where you come from?
What is it?

scripts.speaker: Old Man Nardo
scripts.text:
I hear that, between merchants, {0}? The name seems to pop up a lot. He seems to be talented in the business.
What is it?

scripts.speaker: Old Man Nardo
scripts.text:
Once, I saw a traveler who slipped on a piece of fruit. 'Someone help {0}~' he shouted, which gave me a good laugh.
What is it?

scripts.speaker: Old Man Nardo
scripts.text:
Ah, you again? Thanks for the help back then.
What is it?

scripts.speaker: Old Man Nardo
scripts.text:
I hear that {0} is famous in Baryo. Why don't you try for some fame?

Speak.
Give Spiritual Protection.

scripts.speaker: Old Man Nardo
scripts.text:
Port Malaya is a beautiful city.
The old and new are in perfect harmony.

scripts.text:
Of course there's the recent problem with ghosts wondering about...

About the Ferry Ride

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
The Spiritual Protection you gave me before works fine.
I'm good for now.
It's still up for the fight!
^4d4dffThere is no Spiritual Protection to give to Pedro the Sailor.^000000

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
A newly made Spiritual Protection.
Alright. I'll go at them with this one today.

-Delivered the Spiritual Protection to Pedro the Sailor.-
-With Pedro the Sailor as last, all Spiritual Protections have been delivered.-
-Delivered the Spiritual Protection to Pedro the Sailor.-

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
Hmm... Don't you remember me talking about ghosts?
The Ferry is full of ghosts.
Wait, was it one or many?

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
Whatever. For you and your current condition, it's out of the question.
Yes. You can't do it. You'll be dragged out in a body bag.

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text: Now I'm not going to stand here and wait for that to happen. No way.

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
I'm sorry, but didn't I say something about ghosts over there?
It can't set sail because of that.

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
So what's this whole ghost story about?
Hmmm..........
It's a long story...
I'm listening.
Maybe later.

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
I knew it.
Though, it's not such a boring story.
After all, it is a ghost story.

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
The story goes back to when I first made port here.
It was a nerve racking first time as a liner manager.

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
I was ready to disembark when I saw something I simply could not believe.
Black haze was swarming to the port from all over town.

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
At first, I thought it was just a very thick smog.
As the days went by, it became clear as to what it was.
It was a swarm of souls.

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
A very unpleasant group of souls indeed.
Some were wailing some horrible cries around the Ferry about to set sail...

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
After that incident, that ship stayed on that spot until this day.
Why? Because they took over the ship! It's haunted!

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
If you don't believe me, see for yourself.
Then you'll believe me.

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text: If you want to know, go and see for yourself and get on it.

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
Soul of a Little Girl?
What about all them bullying ones?
They came and went?

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
I don't understand.
Maybe the Leader Mumbaki will know what to do.

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
Hmm... A floral tribute to soothe the soul....
You want to hear its story after it calms down?
Well... Good luck.

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
It can't be helped for the Ferry to set sail again.
I can't go near it because of those mean ones.

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
Now I'm asking you to do this not because I can't be bothered,
but because I simply can't do it myself.

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
Did Mumbaki bless the flower?
I hope this works...
I wish you all the luck!!

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
I hope you can negotiate with success!
I'll take care of those rude ones outside the ship the best I can.

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
I see.
Perhaps the Ferry can move again...
Thank you for all you've done for us.

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
I'd better get ready to set sail then.
It's not much, but this is for you.
If we can get back in business, I'll take you to Izlude for just 1000z.

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
If you want to go to Alberta, use the big ship over there.
This little one goes to Izlude.
That will be 1000z.
Use.
That's a rip off!

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
What?!
How much do you pay for the Alberta Liner to get here!?
Call this a rip off... You think I'm doing charity?

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
The price is 1000 zeny.
I can't help you there~

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
Thank you~
Let's go before the ghosts come back!

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
You know what to do.
Gather the flowers and take it to Mumbaki to get an Offering Bouquet made.

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
Give the Bouquet to Miss Diwata to cheer her up.
....Thank you.

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
Diwata is calm!
I can even feel the difference out here.
I am always in your debt.

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
You know what? Why don't you do this on a more regular basis?
I think you kind of like doing it.

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
Ah, the thing is...
We can't go right now..
You see, the ghosts are back...
I'm fed up with nuisance.

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
I mean... Miss Diwata... Isn't feeling very well and, even with the Spiritual Protection
a normal person can't stand it.
I see. Take care then.
How about a Floral Tribute?

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
I'm glad you understand.
Sigh...

scripts.speaker: Pedro the Sailor
scripts.text:
Hmmm. That would be nice.
If she can be soothed with flowers...!
Good luck.

- A creepy Little Girl is standing.
As our eyes meet, a chill runs down my spine with goose bumps all over. -

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text:
Are you here to bully Diwata too?
I won't have it!
-I was thrown out after the Little Girl's low creepy voice and flash from her eyes.-

- A creepy Little Girl is standing.
As our eyes meet, a chill runs down my spine with goose bumps all over. -

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text:
Are you here to bully Diwata too?
I won't have it!
Wait! I just want to talk!

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text:
Then who are they behind you?
You're one of them!
- Familiar souls are approaching Diwata. -
It's a misunderstanding!
You're from that..!

Just as I thought! You're afraid of me?!
Stand aside!
I need to talk to her.

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text:
I don't know why they're backing away...
You get out of my sight too!
-I was thrown out after the Little Girl's annoyed cry and flash from her eyes.-

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text: Enough!
-I was thrown out after the Little Girl's resolute cry and flash from her eyes.-

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text:
You crawled back in?
Get out-!!!!!
-I was thrown out after the Little Girl's screeching cry and flash from her eyes.-

- The soul of Little Girl Diwata is looking at me fiercely.
No Offering Bouquet...!!!
-I was thrown out with a remote look from her.-

- The soul of Little Girl Diwata is looking at me fiercely. -
- The Offering Bouquet... -
Throw it to the Little Girl.
Slide it across on the floor.

- I threw the bouquet before she could toss me out, and she catches in surprise...
She won't toss me... far, now that she has the flower.-
- I slid the flower across the floor to her. She looks puzzled. -

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text:
What is the meaning of this?
You're not an enemy?

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text:
What? You're an outsider too?
Ha, so live ones are allowed and I'm not?

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text:
Now there's the stereotype of countryside people over outsiders.
I am so annoyed. I feel like wiping them off the map.

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text:
What? I shouldn't?
Why should I not?
I'm stalling the ship?

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text:
I was going to hear you out because of the flowers
but you're telling me lies?!

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text:
So you're saying that I brought these hillbillies on this ship
and that fighting with them is causing the stall?

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text:
... Hmm... Humph. It wasn't what I was intending to do.
But they're the ones who're getting on my nerves!

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text:
... I can't get off anyway.
Which means that I could feel bad again. Got it?

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text:
... I'll try to keep it in today.
It's not because I like the flowers or because I like having company!
It's because I was treated the same way as those cheap ghosts!

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text:
Now if you'll excuse me.
And I'll be clear. I'm not going to hold my temper for so long.

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text: Now, g... go away!

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text:
I promise I'll be a good little girl if those hillbillies leave me alone.
If they bother me again, however, I won't be.

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text:
Surprisingly enough, I'm doing fine.
Of course I'm tense for when they return,
but, as always, I'll win.

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text:
Then the poor crew will cry again
I just can't calm myself down after a fight.

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text:
The flowers you bring makes me calm down.
....
.. It's not because I miss people or I like the flowers. Don't take it the wrong way.

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text:
Get lost!
What? Oh, it's you.
Those hillbillies came back again!
I'm going to kill them!

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text:
It's good to look at flowers from abroad~
Do all flowers from the warm parts of the world smell so nice?

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text:
The flowers you bring makes me calm down.
....
.. It's not because I miss people or I like the flowers. Don't take it the wrong way.

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text:
Darn it! Have you come for more?!
What?
Oh. It's you?
I'm really depressed right now.
- Diwata reached her hands out as if expecting something. -
Give the Bouquet.
Hold her hand.

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text:
What do you think you're doing?!!??!?!!
Arghhhh - I have enough creeps around here, thank you!!
-I was tossed out with Diwata's thunderous cry.-

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text:
What? You want me to wave?
You didn't bring it?
You didn't?!?
Arghhh you just can't trust anybody! Anybody!
-I was tossed out with Diwata's thunderous cry.-

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text:
... Oh... Just as I thought!
My only happiness, my only peace of mind..!
Flowers from abroad~!
-Diwata seems to feel better. The atmosphere shifts to a more refreshing ambience.-

scripts.speaker: Diwata
scripts.text:
Tell Pedro the Sailor!
Diwata will be a goddess of sea, so set sail in my generosity.
- Cannot proceed with the quest. You are carrying too many items. -

scripts.speaker: Kiko in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Welcome to Baryo, stranger.
I am the soul guidance, protector of people and souls here at Baryo.
So, I'm a good leader Kiko in Mumbaki.
Give Cast-Iron Caldron.
Request Purification Ritual.
Exchange Jellopy for gold.

scripts.speaker: Kiko in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
What cauldron?
As far as I know, you're not the one bringing it.

scripts.speaker: Kiko in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Poor thing.
do not live a life of lies.

scripts.speaker: Kiko in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Baryo is not a great place for smithy work.
So we always ask a favor to the forge of Malaya.

scripts.speaker: Kiko in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Bakonawa does not like loud noises.
That's why we beat the sturdy Cast Iron Cauldrons.

scripts.speaker: Kiko in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
The Spiritual Protection is proof that I've got my cauldron,
so deliver it well. Okay? Good.

scripts.speaker: Kiko in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Oh, must be the cauldron I ordered.
But, where is it?
Are you mocking me?!

scripts.speaker: Kiko in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Yes, excellent!
Very Good.
We can aggravate the Bakonawa more with this.

scripts.speaker: Kiko in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
I'll give you this for the cauldron.
I hear you're having some trouble with souls?
Take this. It will help you.

scripts.speaker: Kiko in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
The only purification needed in this village is Vantai's food.
There are no rituals where an outsider, like yourself, can take part in.

scripts.speaker: Kiko in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Vantai must be hungry.
Go give it to him.
Quickly now.

scripts.speaker: Kiko in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Purification of the bones the Guard Dog Vantai needs to gnaw on?
My work here just gets better and better.

scripts.speaker: Kiko in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Go into the forest and fetch me ^4d4dff10 Evil Spirit Bones^000000 and ^4d4dff10 Holy Waters^000000 for the purification ritual.
I'll do the ritual myself.

scripts.speaker: Kiko in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Bones from the animals of this forest all have bad spirits within.
Of course it cannot be helped due to the malignant spirits flailing about...

scripts.speaker: Kiko in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
You do this and do this here and there and...
There. The evil spirit has left and the bone is so pure that you can just chew on it.

scripts.speaker: Kiko in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Now, take this back to Dong the Guard.
Vantai will become stronger after eating this purified Evil Spirit Bone.

scripts.speaker: Kiko in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Moreover, holding on to Evil Spirit Bones will only do you harm,
so I'll take them all to purify.

scripts.speaker: Kiko in Mumbaki
scripts.text:
Oh no you don't!
Don't you dare!
- Cannot proceed with the quest. You are carrying too many items. -

scripts.speaker: Dhong the Guard
scripts.text:
Hi there!
Welcome to Baryo.
You're job seems so hard~
Guard Dog Vantai

scripts.speaker: Dhong the Guard
scripts.text:
Not at all. I just watch who comes and goes from here.
Travelers are the ones who go through more hardship.

scripts.speaker: Dhong the Guard
scripts.text:
Vantai is a nice dog.
He's probably stronger than you.

scripts.speaker: Dhong the Guard
scripts.text:
No offense, but
you look weaker than the original owners of the bones Vantai chews on.

scripts.speaker: Dhong the Guard
scripts.text:
That means just about as strong as me!
Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!

scripts.speaker: Dhong the Guard
scripts.text:
The bones you brought Vantai gave him a feast.
He'll be full and merry for a while now.
Nobody can beat Vantai in recon around here.

scripts.speaker: Dhong the Guard
scripts.text:
Though it is not nice to say a person is lesser than a dog,
but there are some who are lesser.

scripts.speaker: Dhong the Guard
scripts.text:
Vantai?
Always the same.
Now that you mention it, it's almost time for him to get hungry.

scripts.speaker: Dhong the Guard
scripts.text:
Of course, he eats normal dog food, but he can't go without those.
You know what I mean, right?
Smirk...

scripts.speaker: Dhong the Guard
scripts.text:
Me and Vantai are always waiting
for the hero to get us some Evil Spirit Bones from the forest.

scripts.speaker: Dhong the Guard
scripts.text:
What I'm saying is that, to be a good guard dog, he must be able to stand ground against evil spirits.
For that he needs to eat Evil Spirit Bones, but it must be purified before he can eat them.

scripts.speaker: Dhong the Guard
scripts.text:
You can get Evil Spirit Bones from monsters or animals in the forest.
Kiko in Mumbaki will purify them for you.

scripts.speaker: Dhong the Guard
scripts.text:
Kiko in Mumbaki asked for 10 Purified Spirit Bones.
He needs to have at least 10 at a time. Which of course does not last a day...

scripts.speaker: Dhong the Guard
scripts.text:
Hey, Vantai will love these!
It's all in good condition...
An evil bone purified through holy ritual...

scripts.speaker: Dhong the Guard
scripts.text:
This is the perfect dog food!!
Now he can sense and detect evil spirits,
and since he ate purified ones, he'll get the ability to eradicate them.

scripts.speaker: Dhong the Guard
scripts.text:
I bet he's the strongest living thing in the village now.
Of course not me. I mean Vantai.

scripts.speaker: Dhong the Guard
scripts.text:
This is your reward.
It would be very nice if you could help us again tomorrow.

scripts.speaker: Dhong the Guard
scripts.text:
Vantai is not only a guard dog, but he's also a great detector and recon scout.
But for him to do so, he needs to eat Purified Spirit Bones.

scripts.speaker: Dhong the Guard
scripts.text:
As you can see, I can't move from here,
so I was wondering if you can get the bones for Vantai...
Alright.
Sorry.

scripts.speaker: Dhong the Guard
scripts.text:
I see.
Vantai!
No treat for you today..!!
- It seems like Vantai's eyes are more moist today. -

scripts.speaker: Dhong the Guard
scripts.text:
Bones can be acquired from animals or monsters around here.
Take them to Kiko in Mumbaki for purification, which, in turn, can be given to Vantai to eat.

scripts.speaker: Dhong the Guard
scripts.text:
Bring us 10 Purified Spirit Bones.
That reminds me. You'll need Holy Water for the purification ritual.

scripts.speaker: Dhong the Guard
scripts.text:
Take your time.
Look here. Vantai likes it too.

scripts.speaker: Vantai
scripts.text:
Grrrrrrr...
 
(He is intimidated by you.)
- Cannot proceed with the quest. You are carrying too many items. -

scripts.speaker: Maries
scripts.text:
Umm... Hey...
Oh, no, sorry. You don't look so strong or bold.
I'm sorry. I'm just not quite myself...
An anxious looking woman is stands.

scripts.speaker: Maries
scripts.text:
Now that the children know that they can get back home with an Inside-out Shirt,
they play out in the forest recklessly and timelessly.

scripts.speaker: Maries
scripts.text:
The children will surely get lost again in these conditions.
If it happens again, I'll seek your help again.

scripts.speaker: Maries
scripts.text:
I'm missing a child... again.
Oh my goodness...

scripts.speaker: Maries
scripts.text:
You came back.
Thanks to you, the child has returned home safely.

scripts.speaker: Maries
scripts.text:
Although the shirt is inside-out, it miraculously brings them back to where they should be.
Thank you for delivering those precious shirts to my children.

scripts.speaker: Maries
scripts.text:
I'm sure they're lost in the woods because of mischievous spirits.
Please give the child the ^4d4dffInside-out Shirt^000000 when found.

scripts.speaker: Maries
scripts.text:
The Inside-out Shirts...
You can probably get them from the demons, since they ran away with them.

scripts.speaker: Maries
scripts.text:
Hello... I'm looking for my child...
My daughter did not return.
Please help, I think she's lost in the forest.
Of course.
I'm too busy right now.
You have so many children.

scripts.speaker: Maries
scripts.text: I'm sure she's lost in the woods because of mischievous spirits.

scripts.speaker: Maries
scripts.text:
If she's cursed, it will be difficult to get her out of there.
She'll drift around in the maze so mesmerizing, even for you, in fact.

scripts.speaker: Maries
scripts.text:
Acquire an ^4d4dffInside-out Shirt^000000 and give it to my daughter.
Although the shirt is inside-out, it miraculously brings them back to where they should be.

scripts.speaker: Maries
scripts.text:
The Inside-out Shirts...
You can probably get them from the demons, since they ran away with them.

scripts.speaker: Maries
scripts.text:
... Yes... I see.
I'll have to ask someone else.
Alright.
Sigh...

scripts.speaker: Maries
scripts.text:
...I ended up having triplets.
Even I sometimes get confused. *Chuckle*

scripts.speaker: Maries
scripts.text:
They seem to be under a curse because one of them always get's lost in the woods..
Sigh...

scripts.speaker: Little Girl
scripts.text:
He he, the forest is scary, but it's so much fun so I go there often to play~
Strange, how we always get lost.

scripts.speaker: Little Girl
scripts.text:
But it's okay because I'm not the only one getting lost~
We're triplets~ And we're missing the other two~ Giggle~

scripts.speaker: Little Kid
scripts.text:
Sigh. Are you lost too?
They are so naughty.

scripts.speaker: Little Kid
scripts.text:
An Inside-out Shirt is just what I need.
*Chuckle*...

scripts.speaker: Little Kid
scripts.text:
Oh, darn them.
They must have tricked me into getting lost again!
Do you want to go home?

scripts.speaker: Little Kid
scripts.text:
If I don't get back soon, my mom will be worried sick.
Sigh... I wish I had an Inside-out Shirt to go back.
Here you are.

scripts.speaker: Little Kid
scripts.text:
Really?
It really is the shirt!
This will take me straight home!

scripts.speaker: Little Kid
scripts.text:
Did mom send you?
She must be worried..!
I'll go home now!
Thanks' a lot!

scripts.speaker: Little Kid
scripts.text:
I want to play some more.
I can always go back with this shirt.
Mom won't be concerned.

scripts.speaker: Little Kid
scripts.text:
Hmmm. Am I lost again?
Where am I...
I'm sure I have to head in the direction of sunrise from the third tree to get home... Huh?

scripts.speaker: Little Kid
scripts.text:
Why~ Do I always go in circles here?
Do you why, {0}?
What's with this road?
Is somebody trying to trick me?

scripts.speaker: Budidai
scripts.text:
Hey hey hey~
I am such a nice Capre~ Hey!
I am going to a fine cafe~YO!
I am better than yesterday~Hey!
I'm a fine rhyming Capre~Oh?

scripts.speaker: Budidai
scripts.text: Hey buddy, You here to hear Budidai singing?
You like songs?
A profound study of one eyed monsters.
See ya!

scripts.speaker: Budidai
scripts.text:
Yup, Budidai loves singing.
Cows, horses, goats, roosters, boars all love my songs.
They're all friends.

scripts.speaker: Budidai
scripts.text:
Except for that one eyed Bongisungisu.
He picks on my friends.
I am annoyed, but Budidai is weak.

scripts.speaker: Budidai
scripts.text:
I fear it's single gaze, but I fear more the club he flails.
I have to sing my friends some songs, but they don't come because of him.

scripts.speaker: Budidai
scripts.text:
So Budidai, sings here.
Lots of travelers pass by.
Capre is a wanderer's buddy.
You're a buddy too.

scripts.speaker: Budidai
scripts.text:
You interested in that fiend, my friend?
It's just a bully of the forest!
It picks on my animal friends!

scripts.speaker: Budidai
scripts.text:
Sadly, singing is all that Budidai is skilled at.
I can't do anything about the scary gaze and the flailing club.

scripts.speaker: Budidai
scripts.text:
Bongisungisu! I get the chills just by being in the same forest with it...
But Budidai is weak.

scripts.speaker: Budidai
scripts.text:
You and me, wanderer.
We'll never make it.

scripts.speaker: Budidai
scripts.text:
Traveler, my friend!
Bongisungisu ran far far away.
Dogs, cows, horse, goat and rooster will come back to me, won't they?

scripts.speaker: Budidai
scripts.text:
But Budidai is worried.
The one eyed bully will return eventually.
Will you help me out again?

scripts.speaker: Budidai
scripts.text:
You, friend of Budidai
You won't turn you're back on a good Capre?

scripts.speaker: Budidai
scripts.text:
Astonishing, wanderer!
I could hear the pitiful wails of Bongisungisu all the way from here!
Budidai can sing again for his friends, yes?

scripts.speaker: Budidai
scripts.text:
Now, what can Budidai do for the kind wanderer, slayer of the one eyed monster?
Aha! Here's a talisman.
It will be good for you travelers.

scripts.speaker: Budidai
scripts.text:
Kind Capre is a friend of travelers.
I hope to see you again, wanderer.
This is a blessing for friends. Hey hey hey~

scripts.speaker: Budidai
scripts.text:
Please slay the destructive libertine Bongisungisu.
For me, a Capre to sing again for one's friends.

scripts.speaker: Budidai
scripts.text:
Hey, kind wanderer.
Bongisungisu, the one eyed debauchee is back!
What do I do? What should I do?

scripts.speaker: Budidai
scripts.text:
He gets angry when I sing.
But the horse, cow, goat, dog and boars love it.
It gives Budidai such a hard time.

scripts.speaker: Budidai
scripts.text:
You interested in that fiend, my friend?
It's just a bully of the forest!
It picks on my animal friends!

scripts.speaker: Budidai
scripts.text:
Sadly, singing is all that Budidai is skilled at.
I can't do anything about the scary gaze and the flailing club.

scripts.speaker: Budidai
scripts.text:
Bongisungisu! I get the chills just by being in the same forest with it...
But Budidai is weak.
Shall I take care of it?
That does give the chills.

scripts.speaker: Budidai
scripts.text:
Don't remind me.
My friends can't come and listen to my songs because of that behemoth.
It is so frustrating.

scripts.speaker: Budidai
scripts.text:
You'd teach Bongisungisu a lesson?!
Kind wanderer!!
Kick some libertine butt!!

scripts.speaker: Budidai
scripts.text:
Leave me wanderer~
Capre Budidai will sing of wonders~
You best everyone else~
You bring all them beasts~
Just go back to Kafra~

scripts.speaker: Budidai
scripts.text:
Hey hey hey~
Blessing of the Kind and Good Capre~
A wanderer's friend the gift of Capre~
Hey hey hey~
Cannot proceed because you have too many items in your possession.

scripts.speaker: Old Man in Dilemma
scripts.text: Oh! Demons are gaining more and more power in this world.
We need to gather items to fight them off.
Ignore.

scripts.speaker: Old Man in Dilemma
scripts.text: You don't seem to be strong enough to fight off demons.

scripts.speaker: Old Man in Dilemma
scripts.text: Will you create a Greater Agimat of Ancient Spirit with 3 Lesser Agimats and 1,000 Zeny?
Create.
No, thank you.

scripts.speaker: Old Man in Dilemma
scripts.text: Short on materials.

scripts.speaker: Old Man in Dilemma
scripts.text: Hope you win the fight with the demon.

scripts.speaker: Old Man in Dilemma
scripts.text: Can't make it now but there is an old way of making it handed down by generations.

scripts.speaker: Old Man in Dilemma
scripts.text: You need to call upon the power of Ancient Spirits. But you'll need several important materials first.
What are they?

scripts.speaker: Old Man in Dilemma
scripts.text: 3 Lesser Agimats to hold the power of Ancient Spirits here and another special material handed down for generations.

scripts.speaker: Old Man in Dilemma
scripts.text: But nobody can get this special item anymore.
Something money cannot buy?

scripts.speaker: Old Man in Dilemma
scripts.text: No, no... It's this round little thing, you see?
Are you talking about Zeny?

scripts.speaker: Old Man in Dilemma
scripts.text: Looks similar to the special items handed down from generations.

scripts.speaker: Old Man in Dilemma
scripts.text: As long as we have enough of that, we could make the Greater Agimat of Ancient Spirit to fight against the demons.
Sounds good.

scripts.speaker: Old Man in Dilemma
scripts.text: In case you are too weary to take on the demons...

scripts.speaker: Old Man in Dilemma
scripts.text: Come by with 3 Lesser Agimats and 1,000 of those so-called Zeny.

scripts.speaker: Old Man in Dilemma
scripts.text: I will make a Greater Agimat of Ancient Spirit that will increase your attacks against demons by 10% for 20 min.

scripts.speaker: Old Man in Dilemma
scripts.text: Hope you win the fight with the demon.
Cannot proceed because you have too many items in your possession.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: I spent 90% of my life studying Tikbalang.
But you look young?
What is Tikbalang?
Teach me how to catch a Tikbalang.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: What! I might be imagining things.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: I look younger than I am because of my baby face. Ha ha ha~

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: Trust!! They say faith will bring you luck.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text:
Ha ha... You ask the right question.
I'm a specialist in that field. Ask me anything.
Why won't you answer me?

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: Have you... ever been fooled by anyone around you? Why can't you believe someone's word for it? Really, ask me anything.
I don't have any questions.
Characteristics?
Features?
Rumors?
Habitat?

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: I think this is enough explanation for now. You wouldn't understand other highly sophisticated topics with specific terminology and all anyway.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: Oh! Do you have any other questions?

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: What do you think? Impressed at how much I know? Come by anytime when you have any more questions.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: Tikbalangs have a way to confuse travelers when they meet them by making them turn in circles regardless of wherever and how far they travel.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: They are mischievous creatures.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: But of course there is a way to stop their pranks. You know about the Inside-out Shirt? You can either wear your top inside-out.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: Or go on your way quietly without disrupting the Tikbalangs.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: Ha ha ha ha~ But everyone knows adventurers are never quiet while they travel, right?

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: Never...

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: They say Tikbalangs have several distinctions.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: First, they are very tall ^AAAAAA(tsk... wish I were tall)^000000 and have skinny, imbalanced legs and arms. Looks almost like a human but their knees are higher than their upper body when they sit down.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: Second, is the standard characteristics acknowledged by the association. They have heads and feet like a horse.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: So with all these appearance traits, Tikbalang is sometimes called the creature from hell.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: There are several fun rumors about Tikbalangs.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: One of them is about Tikbalangs being the guardians of some kingdom that worships nature.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: So the Tikbalangs will trick travelers who come with bad intentions to the kingdom by making them travel in circles.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: Another rumor is that people around here say that 'if it rains on a clear day, then it must be Tikbalang's wedding day'.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: The association speculates that sayings like 'it rains on Bathory's wedding day' or 'it rains on Moonlight Flower's wedding day' might have derived from the Tikbalang's saying.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: Lastly, ancient fairy tales say that Tikbalangs can transform into human form or even make themselves transparen't but nobody has verified this yet.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: Tikbalangs usually live in dark, busy places where there aren't many people around.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: Hmm... For example, they are known to live beneath bridges, in banana and bamboo forests and beneath large trees.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: And this is just my opinion but wouldn't you agree that they are living in dark places because it is easier to play pranks on people?

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: Ha ha ha. Do you now know how great I am?

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: Oh! Isn't this material to make 'Tikbalang Belt' used to tame Tikbalangs?

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: The '^F80835Tikbalang Belt^000000' is used to capture Tikbalangs without the hassle. But that doesn't mean it's 100% successful. Interested? Do you want me to make one for you?
Yes, I'm interested.
No, I can capture one myself.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: Yiiiiiiiiiiii! Yap!
Huh?

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: The '^F80835Tikbalang Belt^000000' is already created.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: You? Ha... You can try if you want to.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: There is the easy way and the hard way to capture Tikbalangs. Which one do you prefer?
Easy way.
Hard way.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: Ha ha. I've come up with the easy way myself.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: Bring me 3 Tikbalang's Thick Spines and 5 Lesser Agimats to make a '^F80835Tikbalang Belt^000000' to help you easily capture Tikbalangs.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text:
Ha ha ha ha ha!
I will say it again.
It's 3 Tikbalang's Thick Spines and 5 Lesser Agimats. Understood?

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: It's easy for me but I don't know about you.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: Tikbalangs have a sharp, pointy mane behind their neck.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: Of course! There are several of them but you must get the three thickest ones.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: These three manes are the weak point. You can tame a Tikbalang by pulling the manes out.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: Now let me explain how to pull these manes out.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: You must fly like a butterfly and land like a bee on the back of a Tikbalang.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: Of course! The Tikbalang will get mad and try to shake you off with all its might.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: All you have to do is hold on until the Tikbalang gets exhausted.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: Then again, itll take 4 days and 3 nights for Tikbalangs to get tired since they are strong creatures. But let's not focus on too much details.

scripts.speaker: Tikbalang Expert
scripts.text: Which means!! The Tikbalang is already tamed.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: I will upgrade your armor if you bring one that holds enormous power.
What kind of equipment do upgrade?
What are the required materials?
What will it become after an upgrade?
Please upgrade this.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: Your questions are too simple, but!

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: Are also important.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: ^7B4772Bakonawa Scale Armor^000000 made from the scales of the Bakonawa monster known to swallow the moon.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: Light but sturdy ^7B4772Kalasag^000000 made from rattan that grows wild around Port Malaya.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: ^7B4772Buwaya Sack Cloth^000000 made from the sack of the man-eating alligator Buwaya.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: ^7B4772Bangungot Boots of Nightmare^000000 imbued with the hatred and vengeance of the monster Bangungot.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: As just mentioned.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: I will make powerful armor out of ONLY the strongest armor dropped from fearful monsters.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text:
Learned well.
Seems you learned that there is no such thing as free in life.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: First thing to remember is that the object to upgrade must be strong itself. At least strong enough to endure ^FF0000+9 Refinement^000000.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: Next is true strength that only comes out of power obtained naturally. I need ^FF000020 Ancient Grudges^000000 for protection from evil while Im refining.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: When a ^FF0000+9 Refined Strong armor^000000 is combined with ^FF000020 Ancient Grudges^000000 for protection!!

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: You get a completely new and improved armor from old scraps.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: Always look forward to this.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: Listen, because this is a very important question.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: It won't matter if I say it more than a 100 times that upgraded armor is powerful.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: Unless the one that holds it doesn't believe it is! Ask about what has changed and decide for yourself!
There is no more.
Bakonawa Scale Armor
Kalasag
Buwaya Sack Cloth
Bangungot Boots of Nightmare

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text:
Looks like you ran out of questions.
Don't forget. You'll have to give up something to gain something.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: The Bakonawa Scale Armor adds +1 to all stats for all jobs which is overall great armor for everyone.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: But I'm sure the inner you thinks this isn't enough.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: That is why +2 can be added to all stats and an extra slot for a card to your socket if upgraded.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: Kalasag is a good shield to reduce damage from boss monsters by 1% per 3 refinements.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: But not enough. Can't believe that a shield doesnt have a place to equip a card.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: That is why I can add an extra slot for a card to your socket if upgraded.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: The Buwaya Sack Cloth offers healing capacity and healing item effect increase by 1% per 3 refinements. Not to mention it reduces 10% damage from Water, Earth, Fire, and Wind elemental monsters.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: But not enough. Can't believe that these clothes don't come with a place to equip a card. Everyone knows that clothes should have Raydric on them!

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: Don't worry! I can add an extra slot for a card to your socket if upgraded.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: The Bangungot Boots of Nightmare increases +1 MDEF per 1 refinement and speed increases starting at 14 refinement and above.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: The speed increase effect from shoes like Moonlight Flower Shoes and Sleipnir items are out of reach for ordinary people.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: But of course, +14 refinement isn't easy but there is an easy way to get it.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: By upgrading your shoes, you can get speed increase starting from +12 refinement!

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text:
And it doesn't end there!!
I will also put in an extra slot in your socket to add a card.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: However, you'll have to give up something to gain something.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: ^0000FFEquipping the Kalasag, Buwaya Sack Cloth, Bakonawa Scale Armor, and Bangungot Boots of Nightmare all at once will lose the ^FF0000Set Effects^0000FF.^000000

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: Think it through. Next question?

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text:
Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha! Good!
You've brought the materials, right?
Oh... sorry...
Preparations are complete!!

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text:
Oh no!!
I will need an light but sturdy armor with an refinement of +9 or greater and 20 Ancient Grudges!!

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: You said all preparations are done and you give me this?! I need at least 20 Ancient Grudges to refine your item.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: So what armor will it be?
Bakonawa Scale Armor
Kalasag
Buwaya Sack Cloth
Bangungot Boots of Nightmare

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: You should wear the equipment to upgrade and not come without it on you.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: What is this! You said you wanted to upgrade {0} but why are you giving me this? You should be wearing {1}.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: No, the sturdiness of this item has not been tested yet. It'll have to be at least +9 refined for me to say, 'Oh this is pretty sturdy armor.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: Looks like you did your homework! Don't see a flaw! Then I have one question to ask before I start refinement.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: ^0000FFOnce your item is refined, the refinement level will be ^FF00000^0000FF and the item will be upgraded.^000000 You get this part?
No.
Yes.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: What? You didn't know this? Then, read through my instructions and come back again.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text:
Good. Next question. Once refinement is done,
^0000FFEquipping the Kalasag, Buwaya Sack Cloth, Bakonawa Scale Armor, and Bangungot Boots of Nightmare all at once will lose the ^FF0000Set Effects^0000FF.^000000
Do you understand this point?
No.
Yes.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: What? You didn't know this? Then, read through my instructions and come back again.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: Awesome! Then let's start refining {0}.

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: Pow!! Wow!! Flip... flop!

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text: BAM!!

scripts.speaker: Bayani
scripts.text:
Ha ha. Perfect.
Congratulations. Your armor is better than ever.
- From the wary looks on the guard's face, it is obvious he is at alert at the sight of you. He won't intimidate you but seems he won't even deal with you either. -
- Would there be anyone to talk to in the village? -

scripts.speaker: Guard
scripts.text:
There is a small area called ^3131FFBaryo Mahiwaga^000000 outside of Port Malaya.
The place is closer to mother nature than what we have here.

scripts.speaker: Guard
scripts.text: On the other hand, the area is full of fierce monsters. Take care of yourself while you're traveling there.

scripts.speaker: Guard
scripts.text: There are more people leaving the village secretly these days. Are you also heading for the woods to look for the mysterious treasure?

scripts.speaker: Guard
scripts.text: I take that back. On second thought, I don't think a weakling like you would even dare to go there.

scripts.speaker: Guard
scripts.text: You'd better hold tight to your mommy's hand if you want to go outside of Port Malaya or else the monsters will eat you alive. Ha ha.

scripts.speaker: Guard
scripts.text: Is that why there are more outsiders here these days? Now don't be sneaky and a know-it-all. How would you know if I'd offered to take you around?
Treasure?
Ignore.

scripts.speaker: Guard
scripts.text: Are you ignoring me? Bah.

scripts.speaker: Guard
scripts.text: Oh, so you aren't here to look for treasure?

scripts.speaker: Guard
scripts.text: I hear people are talking about a mysterious treasure hidden deep in the woods.

scripts.speaker: Guard
scripts.text:
Do you see that group of people over there? They always gather and talk about it every day.
Try talking to them if you are interested, too.

scripts.speaker: Guard
scripts.text: So the talk about treasure was just a rumor? I'm not asking because I want to be rich overnight. Ha ha.
- Look at you warily while whispering to each other. -

scripts.speaker: Port Malaya Villager
scripts.text:
No, I heard they got lost in the woods.
Who would hide such a treasure from a small village like ours?

scripts.speaker: Port Malaya Villager
scripts.text: Could it been a monster? My grandma said there is a dragon with a huge head living deep inside the woods.

scripts.speaker: Port Malaya Villager
scripts.text: No. Listen to me.

scripts.speaker: Port Malaya Villager
scripts.text:
You all know ^3131FFTotoy^000000? The kid living at the ^3131FFInn^000000.
Well, did you know Totoy came back from the woods recently?

scripts.speaker: Port Malaya Villager
scripts.text: Really??? He came back alive?

scripts.speaker: Port Malaya Villager
scripts.text: Yeah. But the strange part is that the troublemaker ^3131FFTotoy^000000 now quietly stays home and never comes out.

scripts.speaker: Port Malaya Villager
scripts.text: Why?

scripts.speaker: Port Malaya Villager
scripts.text: Don't you get it? Totoy must have found the treasure.

scripts.speaker: Port Malaya Villager
scripts.text: What!!!! Then ^3131FFTotoy^000000 is rich now?

scripts.speaker: Port Malaya Villager
scripts.text:
I don't think so.
I saw ^3131FFTotoy^000000 come back home, but Totoy wasn't carrying anything.
But then, I must have missed it because I ran back home right away.

scripts.speaker: Port Malaya Villager
scripts.text: Then what is ^3131FFTotoy^000000 doing at home?

scripts.speaker: Port Malaya Villager
scripts.text:
I think Totoy is making a plan to bring the treasure back without us knowing it.
To have the whole treasure for himself, that greedy kid.

scripts.speaker: Port Malaya Villager
scripts.text: Is that true?

scripts.speaker: Port Malaya Villager
scripts.text:
The treasure would be in better hands with me ~
I would clean it every day so it shined and would use it as a beautiful ornament. Ah~~~

scripts.speaker: Port Malaya Villager
scripts.text: Then how about we talk to ^3131FFTotoy^000000 to spill the beans on where the treasure is?

scripts.speaker: Port Malaya Villager
scripts.text: Wow. That is an awesome idea. No wonder you're the leader!

scripts.speaker: Port Malaya Villager
scripts.text:
But will ^3131FFTotoy^000000 give up the information easily?
Because Totoy was sneaky enough to think of getting away with taking the whole treasure.

scripts.speaker: Port Malaya Villager
scripts.text: Then we should convince ^3131FFTotoy^000000 to tell us where the treasure is instead of looking for it ourselves.

scripts.speaker: Port Malaya Villager
scripts.text: Ah~~~ it is so hard to get something pretty these days ~~~!!!!
- Better pay a visit to this Totoy to get more information about the treasure. -
- People are talking with serious faces. -
- See someone shaky with dopey eyes. -
- See someone shaky with dopey eyes. -
Tap him on the shoulder.
Ignore him.

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: Wah! No! Go away! Leave me alone!
Hey, are you alright?

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: Huh... you're a person? Who are you?
- He looks you straight in the face but doesn't seem to recognize you. -

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: Who's there?
I am {0}. You are Totoy, right? People say you've found a treasure. Is it true?

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text:
What treasure?
I can't see. I'm blinded. Please help me. I'm tired and frustrated.
What happened?

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text:
Can't talk long. I need to heal my eyes first.
There should be some ^3131FFGreen Potion^000000 left inside the drawer. Will you take it out for me?

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text:
Can't talk long. I need to heal my eyes first.
There should be some ^3131FFGreen Potion^000000 left inside the drawer. Will you get it for me?

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: Hello? Hey, are you still there? What happened to the Green Potion? Jeez, this is driving me crazy.
Hand over the Green Potion.
Do not hand over the potion.

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: Did you really leave? Hey! Darn!

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: Gulp, gulp...

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text:
I can see!! My eyes work!!!
Yay! I feel better now!

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: Wow! You look better than you sounded. Ha ha.

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text:
But what did you say? Something about a treasure?
Did you say I found a treasure?
What is that about?
Tell him what the people are talking about.

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text:
WHAT?
Puhaha! Totoy is rich! Became rich overnight! Chief Ed!

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: Sorry but I went to the woods to collect bugs. Wish I saw a treasure while I was at it. Hmph!

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: I did go deep in the woods because I wasn't getting anywhere with collecting bugs. But who would have thought I'd get into this mess?
What Totoy saw
About bugs

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: I only wanted to show people my collection of cute bugs. Ha ha.

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: Dropping ice or bugs down peoples clothes is just like a daily greeting, isn't it?

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: I love to see people run around the village like they are in a marathon. He he.

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: I thought people wouldn't run away because of an ordinary bug so I went in the woods with Ed.

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: Ah, Ed is my cute puppy. He's very nice and cuddly. My best friend in the whole wide world.

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: Ed usually barks a lot but I should have looked around when he barked and pulled on my sleeves.

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: - Totoy bends over and whispers to you as if walls have ears. -

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: There was a monster with a mouth the size of a house right behind me.
A monster?!

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: Shssh! Be quiet. I've never seen a mouth that big before. It was full of a river of saliva flowing out of spiky teeth. Just the thought of it makes me want to hide.

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: The scariest part is that the monster has two heads. You won't believe it till you see it.

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: Ed bit the monsters leg with all his might to let me get away. But I don't know what happened to him afterwards. Sniff~

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: That's when I hurt my eye. To tell you the truth I don't even remember how I came back.
About the monster

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: Don't know. It was the first time I saw a monster like that. Who could live to tell the story?

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: Wait, maybe the ^FF0000Master of Hunting^000000 might know about the monster. They say he fought with all sorts of monsters.

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: I need some time alone. I need to make a tombstone for Ed. If you want to meet the ^FF0000Master of Hunting^000000, you'll find him near the Weapon Store.

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: And tell everyone else to stop spreading rumors about treasure. They don't know what I went through. Sniff! I'm going to put Ancient Worms in everyones clothes!

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text:
I have to make a grave for Ed. My loyal friend, Ed...
If you want to meet the ^FF0000Master of Hunting^000000, you'll find him near the Weapon Store.

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text:
Ed!! Eeeeeddddddd!!!
Can't believe you gave your life to save me. Wail!!!
- Totoy can't be lying when he's crying his heart out like this. -

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: Where I saw the monster?

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text:
Um... Hmm...
I was so busy running away...

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text:
It was really deep in the woods. Probably even past Baryo Mahiwaga.
I think I heard the sound of ^3131FFFlowing Water^000000. A large whooshing sound. This is all I remember.

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: Poor Ed. I miss Ed. Wail!!!!

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: Poor Ed. I miss Ed. Wail!!!!

scripts.speaker: Dog
scripts.text: Bark bark!!

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text:
Ed!!
Ed!!! You're alive!!!
You've come back!!! I'm so happy!!!!

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text:
Did you bring Ed back?
Thank you so much!
You didn't see the monster, did you?
The monster is called Buwaya. I told the Guard about the monster. You better not go near the place again.

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text:
Okay!
He he. Ed, the woods are too dangerous so we can't go there for bugs anymore.

scripts.speaker: Dog
scripts.text: Whimper...

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: But I'm sure we can find a way to keep our reputation with other creepy stuff!

scripts.speaker: Dog
scripts.text: Bark bark!!

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text:
Anyway, thanks for bringing my best friend back.
I don't have much but would like to thank you. Wait, let me see what's inside my drawer. He he-

- Wait!! -
- You have too many items on you. -
- Cannot receive the item. -
- Clean up your items -
- And please try again. -
- Totoy goes through the drawer, turning it upside down. Making a mess of the room. -

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text: Found it!

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text:
Here. My mom gave it to me but I don't know how to use it... He he.
I hope you can use it.

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text:
Visit me when you get bored!
Just don't ask about the treasure again~!

scripts.speaker: Dog
scripts.text: Woof woof woof!!!!

scripts.speaker: Totoy
scripts.text:
